report:
# FQ-FIVE-IMPORT-PROXY-SEPARATION

Rebuild the five actual RationalCountermodel2x2 objects and evaluate each author-defined proxy: parameter-count equality, one I3 sample, one commutator, three ray inequalities, and an orthogonal determinant-one clock. The native certificate retains every matrix and intermediate value. These weak predicates are not the physical imports; in particular three-ray positivity misses an explicit negative fourth ray.

Supported: The actual 5x5 proxy separation matrix and intermediate rational matrices are checked independently; Lean computes the same declared predicates and a three-ray counterexample.

Remaining: Strengthen and justify the physical interfaces before claiming independence of phase/Born/operator/continuous-dynamics imports. Finite proxy separation does not establish that independence.
